effect Files
    write : (string, string) => Result<int, Error>

install lock = match perform Files.write "osprey.lock" lock
    Success _ => "installed"
    Error message => "rolled back: ${message}"
upgrade () = install "serde = 2"

disk = handler Files
    write path text => writeFile path text
fullDisk = handler Files
    write _ _ => Error(message = "disk full")

print "${disk upgrade} · ${fullDisk upgrade}"
